```{r, ST36 Timed corrected phylogeny from Treetime }

# Ignore negative branches
options(ignore.negative.edge = TRUE)

# Load libraries
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ape)

# Load tree and metadata
tree <- read.nexus("/treetime/core_recomb_removed.fasta.timetree.nex")
metadata <- read_csv("ST36_Global_data.csv")
dates <- read_tsv("treetime/dates.tsv", comment = "#") %>%
  rename(label = node,
         numdate = `numeric date`,
         lower = `lower bound`,
         upper = `upper bound`)

# Extract tree plotting data
tree_plot <- ggtree(tree, mrsd = "2025-03-07", branch.length = "numdate", ladderize = TRUE)
tree_data <- tree_plot$data

# Join CI dates with tree positions
tree_data <- tree_data %>%
  left_join(dates, by = "label")

# Define gridlines
year_breaks <- seq(1970, 2025, by = 5)

# Plot
p <- tree_plot %<+% metadata +
  geom_segment(data = tree_data %>% filter(!is.na(lower), !is.na(upper)),
               aes(x = lower, xend = upper, y = y, yend = y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               color = "black", alpha = 0.3, size = 2) +  # Confidence bars
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Location), size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = year_breaks, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray70", size = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Location", values = c(
    "Australia" = "#4daf4a",
    "New Zealand" = "#377eb8",
    "USA" = "grey",
    "China" = "#e41a1c",
    "United Kingdom" = "#984ea3",
    "Canada" = "#ff7f00",
    "Spain" = "#b15928"
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Year", breaks = year_breaks) +
  theme_tree2() +
  labs(
    title = "Time-scaled Phylogenetic Tree of ST36 Vibrio parahaemolyticus",
    subtitle = "Horizontal bars show node date confidence intervals"
  )

print(p)

#ggsave("/Users/laceyj1/Documents/Safe_Fish_Vibrio/Combined/context_data/ST36_global/Global_extended_ST36_clusters/2025-06-02_treetime/timetree_scaled_by_numdate.pdf", p, width = 8, height = 12)
```
